title: Ternary nanocomposite ReMIL-CN (ReSe2@MIL-53(Fe)@g-C3N4) for energy storage and electroactive integrated H2O2 sensor application
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,42910-42930
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06541K, Paper

Sohail Mumtaz, Sameerah I. Al-Saeedi, Saba Khalil, Abhinav Kumar, Amir Muhammad Afzal, M. A. Diab, Heba A. El-Sabban
The dual-functional potential of the ReMIL-CN nanocomposite material demonstrates remarkable electroactive behavior for advanced energy storage and highly sensitive hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) detection applications.
